input_equivalence.basis: Fourteen public source/test paths change for reviewed chat recovery and principal isolation, authoritative room acknowledgments, media/provider regressions, capture-only frontend reporting builds, and a scoped Windows startup GC mitigation. Dependency manifests and lockfiles, the 1.0.5 runtime version, and all six retained SBOM bytes are unchanged. The only added public source path is ui/react-app/src/sentryTransport.test.js.

qualification.scope: Source-level repairs and synthetic regression coverage; no installer, dependency, release, or publication metadata changes.
qualification.source_integrity: 2490 public source files verified against the regenerated manifest; all six retained SBOM hashes and component counts verified.
qualification.frontend_checks: 1171 tests in 146 files passed on the combined surface/reporting source with the existing lock-matched Linux dependency cache. The later two-file Python-only startup mitigation leaves those frontend bytes unchanged. Release-mode Vite build passed with an empty optional DSN override and source-map credentials removed; the unchanged built-artifact reporting gate passed.
qualification.python_checks: 152 public Python tests passed on the final source with a disposable Linux profile, including the scoped startup guard tests. All 21 inventory evidence contracts passed. Exact-head Windows public CI remains required.
qualification.startup_mitigation: The documented pywin32 issue #691 workaround pauses cyclic GC only around the early win32ui import and restores prior collection state. Synthetic tests cover enabled/disabled state, unchanged thresholds, success and exception outcomes, and helper/platform skips. Installed Windows startup and native GC crash resolution remain unverified.
